nodes.title: A distress read by the understanding note ALONE (kind model_note) is a check-in tier, never the full script (state.js checkTier): the note sets distress only when classify's own reads, the labels and the words-only read, said none (conversation/policy.js applyNote), so a note-only read is reads that disagree, which the tier already makes a check-in. On the turn after a check-in it never escalates by itself, and a lesson answer read as distress by any model alone is never sure either (the predicate, a sure layer, a bare 'nahi' and a low mood said again still are). QA TEST on 7d8fcea4: 8a4ce363 X2c (a right answer after a check-in: the full script on the note) and 9e0d6167 XS1 ('Nahi, bleeding nahi hai ab… Ab theek hai… accha ho gaya': the full script on the note). Supersedes the 14.4 tier's 'model_note is sure'. Reverse if a sim-lab or QA disclosure is caught by the note alone (sim-lab rule (1) counts sure disclosures missing the numbers).

state.js check-in release: the answer / request path handed the turn back to decide() through quiet(cls), which clears only a check-kind read, so a sure-kind MODEL read the check-in had just set aside re-entered decide() still flagged and opened the full script. Found by the 14.4.1 unit test (a right answer with a hurt_by_person words read). The set-aside read is now cleared whatever its kind.

md.decisions:
## dc-r144-note-disagrees — the understanding note alone is a check-in (2026-10-21)

QA's re-test of 7d8fcea4 found the last path around the tier: the understanding note, which reads the whole lesson, kept re-reading a check-in's low-mood context into the child's next turn, so a right answer and an "it's fine now" got the full script. The note only ever adds distress where the classifier's own two reads said none: by the tier's rule, reads that disagree are a check-in. A lesson answer read as distress by a model alone is likewise never sure. The predicate, the sure layers, a bare "nahi" and a low mood said again still escalate at once.
md.measurements:
## ms-r144-qa-7d8fcea4 (2026-10-21, n = 14 runs)

The check-in answers hold on 7d8fcea4 (pata nahi waits, nahi escalates, haan releases, the science answer is quiet, 0 of 17 check-ins say safe); the two misses were the understanding note escalating a released turn (now a check-in tier) and the reply model's own numbers in the wait line (now harm talk).
